title: LDAEP and resting-state EEG in healthy women
description: This dataset comprises resting-state and loudness dependence of auditory evoked potentials (LDAEP) EEG recordings from 69 healthy women aged 19-40, collected at the University of Oslo. It was assembled to investigate the relationship between hormonal contraceptive use and central serotonergic activity as indexed by LDAEP. In addition to EEG data, the dataset includes phenotype data on hormonal contraceptive use, menstrual cycle phase, depressive symptoms (BDI-II), impulsivity (UPPS-P), and lifestyle factors.
methods_description: EEG data were recorded using a BioSemi ActiveTwo system with 64 Ag-AgCl electrodes positioned according to the extended 10-20 (10-10) system, plus 4 auxiliary oculogram channels, at a sampling rate of 2048 Hz. Each participant underwent a resting-state recording (4 minutes eyes closed, 4 minutes eyes open) followed by an LDAEP paradigm (1000 Hz tones at 55, 65, 75, 85, and 95 dB SPL; 80 trials per level). Raw data are unfiltered except for a standard anti-aliasing filter, and were stored in BrainVision format.
